jobs.title: Editor, International
jobs.description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences. About the role: We’re seeking an International Editor to tell Substack’s story across international markets on our owned channels. Together with Substack’s country leads, you will help build a bank of compelling editorial resources for our publishers, and you’ll shape and scale our brand storytelling around the world. This means crafting the strategy for how we tackle editorial needs market by market. You’ll work with translators and local agencies, all while protecting a cohesive Substack brand voice, identity, and quality bar. The ideal candidate is passionate about writing, visual storytelling, and Substack’s mission. They are committed to profiling creators and publishers across the ideological spectrum, quick to grasp complex product storytelling, and excited to help build processes and strategy from scratch. They have demonstrable experience commissioning work that has captured the zeitgeist and enriched culture, and have worked with a range of creatives across disciplines. Ideally, they have also built or expanded an editorial function at a previous organisation. This role is based in London, and reports to the Editorial Lead, with a dotted line to the Head of International. Responsibilities: Create an international storytelling strategy. Build our storytelling surfaces that hero our international creators, drive awareness to new global audiences, and enable our international partnerships team to recruit and retain publishers. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds. Founded in 2021, we’re a 65 -person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries , growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure. ⚙️ The role ScorePlay is the platform major sports organizations use to manage, search and share their media, from the second it's captured to the moment it reaches everyone's screen. A photographer uploads thousands of shots after the final whistle. A live feed has to be logged and clipped into highlights while the game is still being played. The right assets have to reach 10,000+ athletes, partners and newsrooms worldwide, automatically. At 145M+ minutes of video ingested every month and 15+ petabytes stored, much of the architecture needed at that scale simply hasn't been built before. jobs.title: Werkstudent Copywriter
jobs.description: In een notendop Picnic is een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Europa. Als moderne melkboer maken we elke dag duizenden klanten blij met hun boodschappen. Dat doen we verser, goedkoper en groener dan anderen. Onze klanten doen boodschappen en plannen hun maaltijden in onze app en vervolgens bezorgen wij alles gratis thuis. Zonder omweg via de winkel, in elektrische autootjes, met een grote glimlach. Toch is onze website minstens zo belangrijk. Het is dé plek waar we nieuwe klanten naar de app trekken. En daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig! Als Copywriter Werkstudent schrijf je heldere, wil-ik-verder-lezen-webteksten: van pagina’s die onze diensten uitleggen tot tips-en-trickspagina’s en zo nu en dan wat SEO. De kunst van het vak Webcopy: Je schrijft teksten waar je zelf op zou doorklikken. Van pagina’s over onze diensten tot recepttips en inspirerende verhalen over onze makers. De juiste toon: Die weet jij wel te vinden. Want hallo, een tekst over paasrecepten vraagt om iets heel anders dan een verhaal over onze nieuwste appfunctie. Samenwerken: Je spart graag met collega’s, maar gaat net zo graag zelf op onderzoek uit. Samen maken jullie onze website steeds een beetje beter.  Blijven leren: Je leert van ervaren copywriters, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en ontdekt gaandeweg wat een webtekst écht goed maakt. Over jou... Je volgt een opleiding in bijvoorbeeld communicatie, journalistiek, media of creative writing. Je schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en wordt blij van taal, woorden en zinnen die precies kloppen. Spreek je ook nog ein bisschen Duits? Dat is een plus! Je vindt het leuk om langere teksten te schrijven en maakt complexe informatie graag behapbaar. Je hebt gevoel voor structuur: je weet hoe je een tekst logisch opbouwt en online prettig leesbaar maakt. Je hebt gevoel voor humor, al vind je het wat ongemakkelijk om dat over jezelf te zeggen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Picnic perks  🥗Verse

If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements.
